notes.en:
• Security update: repairs a reproduced Agent networking subprocess crash and updates Electron to 43.8.3 for TLS certificate-security fixes.
• Account and update requests omit website-session cookies; Agent direct and proxy routes use patched networking. Existing account login, allowed chat models, credit refresh, API providers, conversations and permissions remain.
• The full dependency audit still contains 68 records / 47 distinct advisories. Read the release verification and remaining conditions before installation.
• Installation is manual: Download opens the public release page; the app does not install updates automatically.
notes.zh-CN:
• 安全修复：修复已复现的 Agent 网络子进程崩溃问题，并升级 Electron 至 43.8.3，包含 TLS 证书安全修复。
• 账号与更新请求不携带网站会话 Cookie；Agent 直连与代理使用修复后的网络实现。保留账号登录、允许的对话模型、充值到账刷新、原有 API 服务、会话和权限。
• 完整依赖审计仍有 68 条记录、47 个独立安全公告；安装前请阅读发布验证报告及剩余适用条件。
• 安装保持手动进行：下载按钮打开公开发布页，客户端不会自动安装更新。
